"""
URL: https://leetcode.com/problems/longest-common-prefix/description/?envType=problem-list-v2&envId=vn57k9wr

14. Longest Common Prefix

Write a function to find the longest common prefix string amongst an array of strings.

If there is no common prefix, return an empty string "".

Example 1:

Input: strs = ["flower","flow","flight"]
Output: "fl"

Example 2:

Input: strs = ["dog","racecar","car"]
Output: ""
Explanation: There is no common prefix among the input strings.

Constraints:

    1 <= strs.length <= 200
    0 <= strs[i].length <= 200
    strs[i] consists of only lowercase English letters if it is non-empty.
"""


class Solution:
    def longestCommonPrefix(self, strs: List[str]) -> str:
        if not strs:
            return ""
        prefix = strs[0]
        for s in strs[1:]:
            # shorten prefix until it matches the start of s
            while not s.startswith(prefix):
                prefix = prefix[:-1]
                if not prefix:
                    return ""
        return prefix


sol = Solution()

print(sol.longestCommonPrefix(["flower", "flow", "flight"]))  # "fl"

assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["flower", "flow", "flight"]) == "fl"
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["dog", "racecar", "car"]) == ""
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix([""]) == ""
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["a"]) == "a"
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["ab", "a"]) == "a"
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["cir", "car"]) == "c"

assert (
    sol.longestCommonPrefix(["a" * 200, "a" * 199 + "b", "a" * 200])
    == "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
)
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["", "abc", "abcd"]) == ""
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["abc", "abc", "abc"]) == "abc"
assert (
    sol.longestCommonPrefix(["z" * 200] * 200)
    == "zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz"
)
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["abcde", "abcdef", "abc"]) == "abc"
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["a", "b", "c"]) == ""
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["prefix", "prefixes", "prefixation"]) == "prefix"
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["same", "same", "same", "same"]) == "same"
assert (
    sol.longestCommonPrefix(["longestcommonprefix", "longest", "longestcommon"])
    == "longest"
)
assert sol.longestCommonPrefix(["", ""]) == ""
assert (
    sol.longestCommonPrefix(["a" * 200])
    == "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
)
assert (
    sol.longestCommonPrefix(["a" * 200, "a" * 199])
    == "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
)
